name: ransomware-incident
description: Critical incident template for ransomware attack response

customFields.name: mitre-tactics
customFields.value: Impact, Execution, Lateral Movement, Defense Evasion

tasks.title: IMMEDIATE: Assess Scope
tasks.description:
## CRITICAL - IMMEDIATE ASSESSMENT

**TIME SENSITIVE - Complete within 30 minutes**

- [ ] Identify initial infected system(s)
- [ ] Determine ransomware variant (ransom note, file extensions)
- [ ] Assess spread - how many systems affected?
- [ ] Identify critical systems at risk
- [ ] Document ransom demands (DO NOT ENGAGE)
- [ ] Notify incident commander

tasks.title: IMMEDIATE: Network Isolation
tasks.description:
## CRITICAL - NETWORK ISOLATION

**TIME SENSITIVE - Complete ASAP**

- [ ] Isolate affected network segments
- [ ] Disable network shares on unaffected systems
- [ ] Block SMB/RDP at network level
- [ ] Disable remote access services if compromised
- [ ] Block outbound C2 communications
- [ ] Preserve evidence - do NOT power off systems

tasks.title: Backup Assessment
tasks.description:
## Backup Status Assessment

- [ ] Verify backup integrity
- [ ] Ensure backups are isolated/protected
- [ ] Determine most recent clean backup
- [ ] Check for backup encryption/deletion
- [ ] Document backup recovery options
- [ ] Test backup restoration (on isolated system)

tasks.title: Evidence Preservation
tasks.description:
## Evidence Collection

- [ ] Capture memory from infected systems
- [ ] Collect ransomware samples
- [ ] Preserve ransom notes
- [ ] Document encrypted file extensions
- [ ] Collect system logs
- [ ] Preserve network traffic logs

tasks.title: Ransomware Analysis
tasks.description:
## Ransomware Identification

- [ ] Identify ransomware family/variant
- [ ] Check for known decryptors (nomoreransom.org)
- [ ] Analyze encryption method
- [ ] Extract IOCs from samples
- [ ] Identify threat actor group
- [ ] Determine attack timeline

tasks.title: Attack Vector Investigation
tasks.description:
## Initial Access Investigation

- [ ] Identify initial infection vector
- [ ] Review email logs for phishing
- [ ] Check VPN/RDP access logs
- [ ] Review vulnerability exploitation
- [ ] Analyze supply chain compromise
- [ ] Map attacker timeline

tasks.title: Lateral Movement Analysis
tasks.description:
## Lateral Movement Assessment

- [ ] Identify compromised credentials
- [ ] Map systems accessed by attacker
- [ ] Review authentication logs
- [ ] Identify tools used (PSExec, WMI, etc.)
- [ ] Determine extent of domain compromise
- [ ] Check for persistence mechanisms

tasks.title: Executive Communication
tasks.description:
## Executive & Stakeholder Updates

- [ ] Brief executive leadership
- [ ] Engage legal counsel
- [ ] Notify cyber insurance carrier
- [ ] Assess regulatory notification requirements
- [ ] Prepare public communication (if needed)
- [ ] Document all communications

tasks.title: Eradication
tasks.description:
## Eradication

- [ ] Reset ALL credentials (assume full compromise)
- [ ] Remove persistence mechanisms
- [ ] Rebuild/reimage infected systems
- [ ] Patch vulnerability exploited
- [ ] Remove attacker access
- [ ] Verify complete eradication

tasks.title: Recovery
tasks.description:
## Recovery Operations

- [ ] Prioritize critical systems for recovery
- [ ] Restore from clean backups
- [ ] Validate restored data integrity
- [ ] Implement enhanced monitoring
- [ ] Gradual network reconnection
- [ ] Verify no reinfection

tasks.title: Security Hardening
tasks.description:
## Security Improvements

- [ ] Implement network segmentation
- [ ] Deploy enhanced endpoint protection
- [ ] Enable MFA everywhere
- [ ] Restrict admin privileges
- [ ] Improve backup strategy (3-2-1 rule)
- [ ] Enhance monitoring and alerting

tasks.title: Post-Incident Review
tasks.description:
## Post-Incident Activities

- [ ] Complete detailed incident timeline
- [ ] Conduct lessons learned session
- [ ] Update incident response procedures
- [ ] Submit to threat intelligence sharing
- [ ] Complete regulatory notifications
- [ ] Update security awareness training
